mapper.select: SELECT a.*, IF(count(b.perm_role_id) > 0, '1', '0') checkArr FROM sys_perm a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM sys_perm_role WHERE role_id = #{roleId}) b ON a.perm_id = b.perm_id GROUP BY a.perm_id
SELECT p.perm_code FROM sys_perm p INNER JOIN sys_perm_role pr ON p.perm_id = pr.perm_id WHERE pr.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.is_enabled = 1 AND p.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND p.perm_code != ''
